author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: For PingOne audit activities in Ping Activity Format from a PingOne webhook, one event per HTTP Ingest record. Point the webhook at the HTTP Ingest URL with Payload Format NDJSON and a custom header Authorization: Bearer <HTTP Ingest key>, so no bridge is needed; the README has the steps. PingOne posts up to 500 events per body, and in NDJSON each is its own line. Sign-on, MFA, lockout, password reset and sign-off action types (PASSWORD.CHECK_*, USER.KERBEROS_*, CIBA_AUTHENTICATION.*, OTP.CHECK_*, ASSERTION.CHECK_*, PUSH_BIOMETRICS.REJECTED, USER and PASSWORD LOCKED and UNLOCKED, PASSWORD.RESET, RECOVERY and SET, SESSION.DELETED, USER.SLO_SUCCESS) go to Auth with the account, address, user agent, application, session, action and result, failure category and MFA flag. Every other action type goes to CloudAudit with the action type as the event name, the acting user or API client, the environment, the user acted on, the result and the resources, and changes flagged as management events. Turn on Include IP address and Include User Agent on the webhook, or the events carry neither. The event time is recordedAt. A whole batch in one record (a JSON array) stays unclaimed. PingOne's data model says result.status is succeeded or failed while its examples show SUCCESS, so FAILED or FAILURE in any case counts as a failure, and otherwise the action type decides. This route hasn't been tested end to end: the parsers passed Run Test on NDJSON lines, but no event was sent through HTTP Ingest, and PingOne's webhook page offers NDJSON while also saying its requests don't use line-delimited JSON. Check that each event arrives as its own record. Samples are made up from PingOne's audit activity data model, its example record and the Audit Reporting Events list; hrefs use api.pingone.example, because the library's sample scan won't take Ping's domains. No built-in parser claimed these lines in 3 Run Tests. The children, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-16 (192 of 192 fields matched the emulator in each of 4 runs), and the parent's confirm string picked the same lines there. Each child also passed Run Test as a separate parser under its parent (192 of 192 fields, each line taken in 5 of 5 runs, no other line taken).
